algorithm.title: Surveillance and evaluation of liver nodules in patients with hepatitis B or cirrhosis

cell.label: Patients with known hepatitis B or cirrhosis: ultrasound every 6 months. Nodule detected?
Repeat ultrasound and AFP every 3-4 months.
Typical vascular pattern (a) seen on two coincident imaging techniques (b)?
AFP >200 ng/mL and typical vascular pattern (a) seen on one imaging technique (b), OR typical vascular pattern seen on two coincident imaging techniques?
Repeat ultrasound in 6 months. Consider CT if alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) is increased or rising.
Proceed according to size of nodule.
Repeat CT or MRI every 3-4 months.

footnotes.footnote: (a) Typical vascular pattern: the lesion is hypervascular in the arterial phase and washes out in the portal/venous phase. All other patterns are considered atypical.
(b) Imaging techniques include ultrasound, CT, MRI, or hepatic arteriogram.
Adapted from Bruix J, Sherman M. AASLD Practice Guideline: Management of Hepatocellular Carcinoma. Hepatology 2005;42:1208-1236.
